description: This file defines the 'Module' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to the 'ohrm_module' database table. It includes properties for id, name, display name, and status, along with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Entity class representing a module in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_module' table, with properties for id, name, display name, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the module.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the module.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the module (active/inactive).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the module.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the module.
